<function=python>
<parameter=code>
nodes = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
greens = [(n['id'], n['pixels'], n['boundary']) for n in nodes if n['color']=='N']

# Click the new green block
if greens:
    b = greens[0][2]
    # center of boundary
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]; cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    cr, cc = (min(rows)+max(rows))//2, (min(cols)+max(cols))//2
    print(f'clicking ({cr},{cc})')
    res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':cr,'col':cc}])
    ng = sum(1 for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N')
    print(f'after: ngreens={ng} done={res.get("done")} level_completed={res.get("level_completed")}')
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
